page.overview:
Who is Aleksander von Helsing?

Aleksander von Helsing was an Imperial rogue engineer, renowned in tales to have invented the von Helsing's Marvellous Machine of Miracles!, a new prototype Steam Tank.

Opinions regarding von Helsing are conflicting. Some consider him a lunatic, while his supporters celebrate him as a genius ahead of his time.

Von Helsing was murdered in Tilea by Prince Ricardo Barolo of Miragliano when he refused to use his work to help the prince build weapons to besiege his neighboring city of Trantio.

It is unknown if von Helsing was in some way related to the eccentric Baron Helbrecht von Helsing of Wurtbad, a wealthy noble and cousin to the Elector Count of Stirland. Helbrecht von Helsing is also a well-known engineer who invested his talent in improving the Steam Tank later known as the Miragliano.
